**Cause:** `OrdersPage.__init__` registered only the `refresh` button. `click("export")` found no handler and silently did nothing. The existing export test called `page.export()` directly, so it never exercised the button and passed anyway.

**Change:**
- `src/orders-web/orders_page.py`: register `export` next to `refresh`.
- `tests/test_orders_web.py`: added `test_export_button_writes_one_download`, which clicks the button.

- verified: the full suite (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`) runs 9 tests, all passing.
- verified: only `OrdersPage` callers are in the tests, so nothing else calls the changed code.
- inferred: the Export button works in the real app. This sample has no running app, so I could not check it in the UI.
